name: io.github.Sagargupta16/bedrock-multi-model-mcp
title: Bedrock Multi-Model
description: Ask, compare and judge 26 AWS Bedrock text models, plus image, video and embeddings.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
environmentVariables.description: Bedrock API key. Leave unset to use the standard AWS credential chain.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Region for text and embedding calls (default us-east-1).

environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Named AWS profile, when using IAM credentials instead of a bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: BEDROCK_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for generated images (default: cwd, or ~/bedrock-images).
